source_text.suspicion: Restricted entity fields (Exam.on_install/2 entity_field_restrictions rows) reach restricted callers through entity-record create/update events exposed under the synthetic per-entity-type instance on the /instances read routes.

task.description: Prove or withdraw the suspected events/instances leak of restricted entity fields with one real-HTTP-router test file. No lib/ or priv/ edits.

result.summary:
LEAK PROVEN on main (lib == main). Test file test/letflow/routers/instances_restricted_field_events_test.exs (uncommitted, mix-formatted, `mix format --check-formatted` clean), run under the machine mutex with 4.98 GB free: `MIX_ENV=test timeout 540 mix test --warnings-as-errors <file>` -> 'Result: 5/13 passed, Failed: 8 tests' (no warnings). Setup: provisioned tenant, real exam shapes (question{stem,explanation}, answer_option{question_id,text,is_correct,likert_weight,likert_polarity}), Exam.on_install/2 seeds the entity_field_restrictions rows, Records.create_record answer_option (is_correct true, likert_weight 7.25) and question (explanation marker). Tokens: TASK_WORKER and TENANT_AUDITOR (both hold :InstancesRead). Assertions are presence/absence booleans only; no restricted value is interpolated into a failure message.

FAILING (= leak proven), each for BOTH TASK_WORKER and TENANT_AUDITOR (8 tests):
(a) GET /api/v1/instances?page_size=100 -> 200 and the list CONTAINS the synthetic answer_option and question entity-type instances (observed {true,true}). Missing exclusion: Letflow.Instances.list/2 (lib/letflow/instances.ex:87-109) queries InstanceProjection with no predicate excluding entity-type synthetic instances.
(a2) GET /api/v1/instances/:synthetic_id -> 200 (desired 404). Missing: Letflow.Instances.get_by_id/2 (lib/letflow/instances.ex:56-69), Repo.get on the projection with no exclusion; router handle_get_by_id/render_get_by_id (lib/letflow/routers/instances.ex:832-862) just serialises it.
(b1) GET /api/v1/instances/:synthetic_id/history -> 200 and at least one event payload carries a 'field_values' map including restricted keys (is_correct / likert_weight / explanation) and the restricted likert_weight value is in the body. Missing: Letflow.Instances.history/3 (lib/letflow/instances.ex:130-154) uses exclude_hidden_event_types/1 (instances.ex:452-455) which hides only VariableMerge.sys_event_type(); Letflow.Api.Response.public_event_payload/2 (lib/letflow/api/response.ex:97-115) strips only variables/output_variables/initial_variables maps and the applied-event payload, never 'field_values'; router history_item_map (routers/instances.ex:960-970) emits the payload through it.
(b1q) same route for the synthetic `question` instance: the restricted question.explanation marker is present in the 200 body (FAIL).

PASSING (5 tests): (b2) GET /instances/:id/timeline for the synthetic answer_option instance -> no restricted value in the body for either role (timeline_item_map, routers/instances.ex:996-1009, and Instances.timeline_item/2 emit only node_id, task_id, metadata (events.metadata, %{} here) and a description string, never the payload; NOTE the route still returns the synthetic instance's event list, only the payload is not leaked, so it is not a clean bill: record_id is not emitted but event_type ENTITY_RECORD_* and sequence are visible). Controls: (c1) TASK_WORKER POST /api/v1/entities/query -> 200, is_correct and likert_weight come back as the sentinel '__field_redacted__' (redaction is by sentinel value, not key removal) and no marker in the body; (c2) weak control: TENANT_ADMIN list 200 and nonexistent-id history/timeline 404 (no real workflow instance is created in this file; the normal-workflow-history control is therefore NOT genuinely exercised, flagged as a gap); (c3) a TASK_WORKER holding a user_entity_grants row for answer_option.is_correct sees is_correct == true via /entities/query.

ROOT CAUSE chain: Records.build_event_attrs/3 (lib/letflow/entities/records.ex:824-832) puts the full ctx.field_values into the ENTITY_RECORD_CREATED/UPDATED payload; the event is appended under the instance_id returned by EntityTypeInstance.get_or_create/2, which also inserts a real instance_projections row (status :active, definition_id = instance_id). The /instances read stack has no notion of synthetic instances and no field-restriction pass over event payloads. The live INSERT into events in the test log shows the payload stored with 'field_values' => {'explanation' => marker, ...}.

SYNTHETIC-INSTANCE PREDICATE (for PR-0b; no code changed): the only structural marker is the entity_type_instances table (PK entity_type, column instance_id; schema Letflow.Entities.EntityTypeInstance), so the exact predicate is `instance_projections.instance_id IN (SELECT instance_id FROM entity_type_instances)` (tenant-prefix scoped; Ecto: exists/in subquery on EntityTypeInstance). There is no flag column on instance_projections. A cheaper convention-based single-column predicate also holds by construction: `instance_projections.definition_id = instance_projections.instance_id` (ensure_instance_projection/2 in entity_type_instance.ex:142-155 deliberately reuses the minted instance_id as definition_id; moduledoc/design item flags it as a placeholder, a real instance's definition_id is a process_definitions id and cannot equal its own instance_id). The table-join predicate is the authoritative one; the definition_id==instance_id form is a convention that a future change to the placeholder would silently break. Platform sentinel instance (EventStore.platform_instance_id()) is a separate synthetic row not covered by either predicate (not investigated further).

CONSUMER CHECKLIST of event payloads / field_values (grep-level, no deep audit; entity events live in the tenant `events` table under the synthetic instance_id):
1. Webhooks (Letflow.Webhooks.deliver/3, lib/letflow/webhooks.ex:247; routers/webhooks.ex deliveries route): outbound. grep finds NO production caller of Webhooks.deliver in lib/ (only its own definition and docs/design), so no event -> webhook path exists today; deliveries route returns webhook_delivery_attempts (not entity events). Not exposed by this path today; becomes outbound exposure if anything later feeds event payloads to deliver/3.
2. Dead-letter queue (Letflow.Dlq, routers/dlq.ex:221): returns source_payload, which is the webhook delivery payload (webhooks.ex land_in_dlq). Not entity events today (follows from item 1). Role-gated DLQ route.
3. Audit entries (Letflow.Audit, GET /audit, routers/audit.ex): reads audit_entries, not the events table; grep of lib/letflow/entities/records.ex and event_store*.ex finds no Audit write carrying field_values. Not exposed (event_store.read_global/1, which does read raw events with global_seq, has NO caller outside docs/tests per grep).
4. EventStore.read_global/1 (event_store.ex:1198): raw events incl. payload (resolve_payloads), instance_id filter. No router/lib caller found by grep: INTERNAL ONLY today, would expose full field_values if wired.
5. GET /instances/:id/history: EXPOSED (proven above; both roles).
6. GET /instances/:id/timeline: payload NOT exposed (proven b2); event listing of the synthetic instance visible.
7. GET /instances and GET /instances/:id: EXPOSE the existence of the synthetic instance (proven a/a2); instance_map returns Response.public_variables(projection.variables) which is %{} for these; no field_values there.
8. GET /platform-events (routers/promotions.ex:994, EventStore.list_platform_events/1, event_store.ex:1281-1300): filtered to instance_id == platform_instance_id(), so it does not read entity-type instances' events. Not exposed.
9. Response.public_event_payload/2: the sole payload shaper for history; does NOT strip field_values (api/response.ex:97-115). It is the natural single fix point for history but cannot know the caller's restrictions (no opts), so hiding the synthetic instance at the source (404) is the cleaner fix.
10. Entity-record projection: Letflow.Entities.Record.Projector (entities/record/projector.ex:134,240) reads EventStore.read(instance_id) to rebuild entity_record_latest; internal, not a client route. /entities/query, aggregate and export read entity_record_latest with redaction (c1 proves redaction on query). 
11. Event export / archival: EventStore archive + RetentionOperations + EventHistoryRetirement + ArchivedEvent (event_store/*.ex) move/copy events to events_archive internally; no client export route found for raw events; not exposed to a role via a route found by grep.
12. Tasks router (routers/tasks.ex:368) references InstanceProjection only to check the owning instance is not :active; no payloads.
13. Engine.Reconstruction (engine/reconstruction.ex) and POST /instances/:id/reconstruct: reconstruct replays events for an instance; the response (routers/instances.ex:729-750) returns token_map/status, not payloads; reconstruct on a synthetic id was NOT tested (not asserted either way).
14. Lua platform emit_event hook (engine/lua/platform.ex) and Obs.Alerts/metrics: reference projections/events as counts/metadata; NOT audited for field_values.
15. Search, websocket/SSE/stream: no matching module found by Glob (no search/sse/stream/outbound files under lib/letflow); logs/telemetry: not audited (the test-env Ecto debug log prints event INSERT params, test-only config; production log level/telemetry not checked).
Not verified at all: other routes returning instance_projections rows (only the Instances router and Tasks router were read), POST /instances/:id/cancel / rebind-pins on a synthetic id (writes, not tested).

RISK NOTE for the fix owner: in the 8 failing cases the status is 200 with real values; the query-route redaction sentinel is '__field_redacted__' (not key removal), so a desired history behaviour of 'present but redacted' would need that same sentinel; the simplest consistent fix is 404 at Instances.list/get_by_id/history/timeline for synthetic ids (INV-5 style, byte-identical to a nonexistent instance), which would turn all 8 failures green and keep b2/c1-c3 green. The a2/b1/b1q/b2 tests accept 404 only for a2; b1/b1q/b2 accept any non-200 or a clean 200.
